column2: Reach the last stone with minimum cost|A friendly first dynamic programming problem
Move forward by one or two stones|Pay the height difference
A cheap jump now may force a costly jump later|Remember the best full route to each stone
Minimum total cost to reach stone i|Base case: dp[0] equals zero
Try the final jump from i minus 1|Also try i minus 2 when it exists
Fill the table from left to right|O(N) time and O(N) space
